这是一个邮件，我写了一个推荐信，帮我回复这个邮件： 发件人：Christine Chan <***@***>
发送日期：2026-08-28 14:52:24
收件人："***@***" <***@***>
抄送人：Kery Ng <***@***>
主题：RE: HKU - Reference for Ms HE Yuqing


Dear Ms Zhang

My email below may have escaped your attention. I would be grateful if you could provide us with a reference letter for Ms He.

Many thanks for your assistance.

Regards
Christine

 

From: Christine Chan
Sent: Thursday, August 20, 2026 4:34 PM
To: 'y撤销***@***' <***@***>

Cc: Roy Tran <***@***>; Kery Ng <***@***>
Subject: HKU - Reference for Ms HE Yuqing
Importance: High

 

Dear Ms Zhang

 

Greetings.  We are writing to you as Ms HE Yuqing has named you as her referee in her application for the post of Teaching Assistant in the Faculty of Education.

 

She has now been selected for the said position, and accordingly I write to invite you to provide us with a reference letter commenting on her research, teaching and administrative capabilities.  Please rest assured that your assessment will be kept in strictest confidence and in compliance with the local Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance which safeguards your anonymity.  We hope that with this assurance you will be able to provide an open and frank letter of your impression of the applicant.

 

To give you some background information, the requirements of this position are extracted below:

 

“Applicants should possess a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Information Technologies, Education, or a related field. Those with teaching experience and familiar with the CCC courses at HKU are highly preferable.

 

The appointee will assist the course coordinator in the teaching of the CCC course CCST9076, conducting small-group tutorials, marking assignments, preparing materials, supervising student work, co-grading all final assignments according to the course requirements, and undertaking related tasks as assigned."

 

It would be most appreciated if you could provide us with a reference letter on or before August 27, 2026, so that we can proceed with the recruitment as early as possible.  Your confidential reference letter can be addressed to Professor Yang Rui, Dean and Chairperson of the Faculty Human Resource Committee, and can be sent to me by email (***@***).

 

We thank you in advance for your kind assistance.

 

Regards

Christine



******************************************

Christine CHAN (Ms)

Executive Assistant

Human Resources (Academic Staff)

Faculty of Education

The University of Hong Kong

Room 420, 4/F, Meng Wah Complex,

Pokfulam Road, Hong Kong SAR

Tel: (852) 3917 8003 Fax: (852) 2517 0075

******************************************

assistant_contents.content:
草稿已保存到 `AI 工作区/成果文件/.../2026-09-03_回复邮件草稿.md`，正文如下（英文，直接可用）：

---

**To:** Christine Chan <***@***>
**Cc:** Kery Ng <***@***>
**Subject:** RE: HKU - Reference for Ms HE Yuqing
**附件：** TA_ZHANGYANBIN_Letter_of_Recommendation.pdf

> Dear Ms Chan,
>
> Thank you for your email and for the kind reminder. My sincere apologies for the delayed reply.
>
> Please find attached my confidential reference letter for Ms He Yuqing, in support of her application for the Teaching Assistant position in the Faculty of Education. The letter comments on her research, teaching and administrative capabilities, based on my close collaboration with her as her project supervisor at the School of Data Science and Engineering, East China Normal University.
>
> Should you or the Faculty Human Resource Committee require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
>
> Thank you again for your patience and assistance.
>
> Kind regards,
> Yanbin Zhang
> School of Data Science and Engineering, East China Normal University
> Email: ***@***

---

几点提醒：
1. **发送时记得附上 PDF**（就是那份 8 月 20 日落款的推荐信）。
2. 对方最初要求信可致 Professor Yang Rui（Dean and Chairperson of the Faculty HR Committee）。你 PDF 的抬头写的是 "Dear Hiring Committee and Course Instructors"，通常也接受；如果想更稳妥，我可以帮你把抬头改成 "Dear Professor Yang Rui" 出一版新的。
3. 今天是 9 月 3 日，已过对方 8 月 27 日的期限，所以开头加了道歉措辞——语气客气但简洁，不啰嗦。

需要我调整措辞、改抬头，或者生成一份 Word 版方便你编辑吗？
